postgresql.releaseChannel: Maven Central artifacts published by zonky/embedded-postgres-binaries
postgresql.container: jar (zip) wrapping a tar.xz of the PostgreSQL distribution
postgresql.hashSource: official repo1.maven.org .sha256 sidecar of the pinned artifact
postgresql.selectionReason: zonky/embedded-postgres-binaries is a maintained project that repackages official PostgreSQL releases into per-OS/arch artifacts on Maven Central with checksum sidecars; it is the only tracked distribution covering both darwin arm64 and amd64 for PG 16/17 without a GUI app or package-manager linkage.

rejections.Postgres.app: GUI app bundle; upstream documents the binaries as not intended for standalone redistribution.
rejections.Homebrew bottles: linked against /opt/homebrew prefix paths and transitive dependencies; not portable.
rejections.EDB installers: interactive installer format, not a portable tarball.

placeholder.behavior: executable stub that prints a loud startup error naming this lock entry and exits non-zero; real binary replaces it once a source resolves
placeholder.reason: Redis Ltd publishes no official darwin binaries; valkey GitHub releases carry no binary assets (source tarballs only); Homebrew bottles are linked to /opt/homebrew and drag transitive deps (openssl@3), so they are not portable; known community builds are stale forks or docker-only images. Re-evaluate when Redis ships official darwin binaries or a maintained, checksummed static darwin build appears.

rejections.Homebrew bottles (ghcr.io/homebrew/core/: non-portable: dylibs resolved under /opt/homebrew plus transitive dependencies; bundling them means hand-rolling a mini package manager.
rejections.valkey-io/valkey GitHub releases: no binary assets published (verified on 2026-08-27 for 9.1.1: source tarballs only).
rejections.community GitHub builds (e.g. zero-team-: docker images or stale one-off forks; no maintained checksummed darwin artifact.
